scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec corporacao_backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: docker exec corporacao_backend npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint || true && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test || true && cd ../frontend && npm test
